findings.evidence:
Run-1 fix #6 (WS reconnect banner gated by app_env=local) was applied to the GLOBAL ConnectionStatusBanner (the orange/yellow connection-status-banner--reconnecting component). KDS state 04 confirms that fix landed: the connection-status-banner Vue component is no longer instantiated; only the cyan 'Mode secours actif — actualisation automatique toutes les 5s' info banner is rendered. HOWEVER the POS tracker has its OWN separate banner:
Connexion temps réel perdue — actualisation automatique en cours…
— present in states 06 and 08 (pos-tracker-rt-warn appears 2x in each DOM, confirmed visible in PNGs as a yellow full-width band immediately below the 'Suivi commandes' header that pushes the tracker grid down by ~40px). The POS tracker banner was NOT gated by app_env, so the run-1 fix only half-landed. The KDS-style 'Mode secours actif' message is NOT rendered on the POS tracker, so the chef sees one banner on KDS while the cashier sees a different (more alarming) banner on POS — inconsistent dev-noise UX between the two surfaces.
findings.fix_hint: Apply the same APP_ENV gate to the pos-tracker-rt-warn component. Either (a) hide the banner when app_env=='local' so dev WS noise doesn't surface, or (b) replace it with the same 'Mode secours actif — polling toutes les Xs' info-style banner used on KDS so the messaging is consistent across surfaces. Search the POS tracker Vue component (data-v-022c4396) for the v-if controlling the rt-warn render and add the env guard.

However the run-1 B-009 numeric-conflict bug remains: at the same moment the receipt modal renders the paid amount (effective total 2.00€), the underlying cart sidebar pos-grand-total reads 0.00€.
